The '''three punks''' are [[Pokémon Trainer]]s in the [[Orange Islands]]. They are [[Character of the day|characters of the day]] who appeared in the {{aniseries|OS}} episode ''[[EP084|The Lost Lapras]]''.

==In animation==
===History===
{{Ash}} and {{an|Misty}} discovered the three punks abusing a {{AP|baby Lapras|Lapras}}. Apparently, they wanted to use it to travel through the [[Orange Islands]] so that they could challenge the [[Orange League|Orange Crew]]. They struck it repeatedly with sticks in order to get it to move. They were confronted by Ash and Misty and a battle ensued. As they were about to begin, they were stopped by a then unknown {{Tracey}} who examined their Pokémon. He stated that all of their Pokémon were "pitifully underdeveloped". While Tracey was about to test {{AP|Pikachu}}'s {{m|Thunder Shock}}, the three punks attacked. Pikachu let out a strong Thunder Shock attack which shocked them and their Pokémon, as well as Tracey. The three punks then ran away in fear.

Because of what these Trainers did to it, Lapras started off not trusting humans. It eventually had a change of heart by the end of the episode once it saw what Ash was willing to do for it.

==In the manga==
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
[[File:Punks EToP.png|thumb|200px|The three punks in The Electric Tale of Pikachu]]

The three punks appear in ''[[ET14|The Orange Islands]]'' as a set of Trainers who are the first ones Ash met on the Orange Islands. They reappear in a flashback in ''[[ET17|The Orange Crew Supreme Gym Leader]]''.

Unlike in the animated series, the trio do not beat up a {{AP|Lapras}} as a group of {{p|Krabby}} do it instead.
